from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    def scan(cells, dr, dc):
        i=0
        while i<len(cells):
            j=i
            while j+1<len(cells) and cells[j+1][2]==cells[i][2] and cells[i][2]!=bg: j+=1
            if j>i:
                v=cells[i][2]
                fr,fc=cells[j][0]+dr, cells[j][1]+dc
                fwd_free = 0<=fr<h and 0<=fc<w and g[fr][fc]==bg
                if fwd_free:
                    r,c=fr,fc
                    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=v; r,c=r+dr,c+dc
                else:
                    r,c=cells[i][0]-dr, cells[i][1]-dc
                    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and g[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=v; r,c=r-dr,c-dc
            i=j+1
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        key = (lambda r,c: r-c) if dc==1 else (lambda r,c: r+c)
        for s in range(-(h+w), h+w):
            cells=sorted((r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if key(r,c)==s)
            scan(cells,dr,dc)
    return out
